Authors of the documents explaining the 1970s US stagflation

Source: R/Authors_stagflation.R
Authors_stagflation.Rd

All the authors of the documents of Nodes_stagflation that explain the stagflation (Nodes_stagflation only gives the first author), from the corpus of Goutsmedt (2021) . It can be used to build networks of authors.

Usage

Authors_stagflation

Format

A data frame with 231 rows and 3 variables:

source_id

Identifier of the document.

author_name

Name of the author.

author_order

Rank of the author in the list of authors of the document.

Source

Goutsmedt (2021) .

References

Goutsmedt A (2021). “From the Stagflation to the Great Inflation: Explaining the US Economy of the 1970s.” Revue d'Économie Politique, 131(3), 557–582. https://www.cairn.info/revue-d-economie-politique-2021-3-page-557.htm.
